description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_InventoryRestock"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-restock">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryRestock">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderToSuppliers" name="Place order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SuppliersToReceipt" name="Deliver stock" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryRestock" name="Inventory restock" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Begin monitoring inventory"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Stock reaches predefined threshold?" default="Flow_NoThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethod" name="Signal method"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Send automated reorder alert"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check and signal reorder need"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Merge reorder signals"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderSuppliers" name="Consider cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectStock" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in the system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StoreStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Inventory levels updated"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMonitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockAtOrBelowPredefinedThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoThreshold" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAutomatedAlert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToManualCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedAlertToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheckToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToConsiderSuppliers" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_ConsiderSuppliers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderToPlaceOrder" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderSuppliers" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrderToUpdateDates" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDatesToReceive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToInspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToRecord" sourceRef="Task_InspectStock" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToStore" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_StoreStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StoreToUpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_StoreStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevelsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
